nb2_lite.texto: A photograph of the same person shown in the reference image. The same young fair-skinned doctor in shirt sleeves, tie loosened, slim build. He types the warning letter to Perth on a black manual typewriter. Australian men of predominantly British-descended appearance with fair skin. 1948 bare timber-and-corrugated-iron office, wooden desk, filing cabinet, Bakelite telephone, window onto dust haze. Hard late-afternoon light through a dusty window. Medium shot, over-the-shoulder eye-level, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field focused on the sheet. A grainy 35mm documentary photograph in the style of 1948, with muted colors and slight underexposure, in a dark-history realist style. The image has a 16:9 aspect ratio.
